about_the_game:
The psychological visual novel FISSURE follows the journey of Levi and his friends Amina and Mateo who achieved their lifelong dream of becoming detectives. However the dream that they had always wanted has already started to decay.

The three detectives must collaborate immediately after Amina and Mateo break their engagement through their silent arguments and physical abuse and unspoken issues. You find yourself trapped between the case work of Levi while witnessing the gradual destruction of everything around him.

Your investigation reveals that Vanya is no longer the main focus. The investigation transforms into an exploration of their deception patterns and their conflicting memories and the persistent doubt that gnaws at you:

"Did I ever really know them at all?"

⸻

This game is not about solving a case.

You observe how your loved ones transform before you while questioning if you remain part of their lives.

Levi – A young, wide-eyed detective whose desperate to prove himself. Levi dreams of big city cases but finds himself caught in a mystery that’s far more personal than he expected.

Amina – Sharp, determined, and unwilling to sugarcoat the truth. She tackles every challenge directly by using methods that sometimes damage relationships.

Mateo – Calm, charming, and seemingly unbothered by the chaos around him. His relaxed demeanor conceals thoughts which he rarely expresses to others.

Daily Investigations – Uncover new clues each day as the case unfolds.

Choice-Driven Story – Your decisions shape Levi’s relationships and the truth you uncover.

Interactive Environments – Search desks, examine objects for hidden details and just snoop around because why not!

Workplace Favors – Help out your colleagues… or don’t, it’s your call.

Exploration – Visit and investigate multiple locations, from cozy offices to eerie abandoned factories.

⸻

We’re Llama and Loosh — two South African teens who just wanted to make a game we’d love to play. Fissure is our little passion project, built with ALOT of late nights and a lot of heart. We hope you have fun playing it, and if you enjoy it, we’d be so grateful for your support. Every download, share, and kind word means the world to us.

content_descriptors.notes: Depictions of violence and disturbing imagery, references to sensitive topics, alcohol use.
